nom: Well People Daygleamer Mineral Sunscreen Serum Broad Spectrum SPF 34

avis.texte: It is mineral and glides on so easily. I have sensitive skin and no problems so far. Its milky thin texture works great with the complexion stick. It is light to medium coverage.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Great product! I love that it is a mineral sunscreen, it makes me feel better wearing this while on vacation being in the ocean. It feels wonderful on my skin and doesn't leave my skin feeling greasy. It absorbs into the skin leaving me feeling dewy and hydrated

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] like the texture, and although i appreciate it not having a ton of added fragrance, it doesn't smell the best. but the scent doesn't linger. once fully buffed into the skin the finish is nice.

avis.titre: The Sun Protection of your Dreams
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I swear this stuff is magic in a bottle. It works wonderfully as sun protection and also doesnt leave a white cast. It dries down so nice and doesnt leave your skin feeling oily. Its extremely lightweight and sits so nicely under makeup.

This day day gleaner mineral serum goes on smooth & it did not leave my face white & it absorbs quickly. I don't think it's waterproof so it wouldn't be a option for the pool or beach ⛱️. This product I reviewed in exchange for my honest review.

I'm a very skeptical person, especially when it comes to facial products. I don't really like putting things on my face because I'm sensitive my face get irritated, but this product will be my number one. I will definitely keep on trying this.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was excited to try this out as I've heard great things about mineral sunscreen. The texture was definitely different than the normal sunscreen I use (a spray) but it did feel like it stayed on longer. I usually do 50spf but I noticed no difference in the protection. The packaging was sleek and easy to open and apply to myself and my husband. Overall it was a good experience and I will definitely continue using it this summer!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is really nice SPF. I love that it's a mineral formula, but it doesn't leave a white cast. It's quite watery as far as the texture goes, and it blends in really well. It feels more like a serum than an SPF. I didn't notice a sent with it either which is nice. I'm very happy and love wearing this.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like clean product. Its serum-like texture absorbs quickly, leaving no white cast (if you use the right amount), and provides a radiant finish that works well under makeup. I definitely buy it again after finishing this bottle. The only minus point for me is the SPF is little bit low (34). But I am still happy with this sunscreen serum.
This was my first time trying this sunscreen, but I love it. It was not heavy, it did not have a strong smell and it lasted all day.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] its lightweight, moisturizing, and non-greasy. it doesn't leave a white haze behind and provides a smooth finish. clean ingredient list a great option for daily wear and under makeup.
Love this product! Goes on smoothly and no strong scent! Good consistency as well!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Love how lightweight this sunscreen serum is. It's supposed to help brighten your skin over time of you wearing it. Like with any makeup/skincare products, make sure your foundation or other skincare products' formula won't clash with this so it doesn't clump up on your face.
Extremly light texture. Serum like consistency, easy to apply and comfortable on the skin. This SPF is perfect for under make up. I love that it is not heavy or has a white cast!

avis.titre: Sleek and light.. perfect for on the move
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] The sunscreen felt so light and soft. You wouldn't be able to tell that it's a sun screen. It was small sleek packaging which makes it easy to take it to go! I took it to my trip to Vegas and you would have never guessed i was wearing sunscreen! But it did its job.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I typically don't use sunscreen because of the white cast but this doesn't have any. There is no strong awful scent and has smooth texture. Perfect packaging for traveling

Well People Daygleamer Mineral Sunscreen glides on super smoothly, no weird stickiness, and it absorbs fast without leaving a greasy finish. The formula feels hydrating yet lightweight. I have olive skin and this does not leave a white cast, but it does leave a glowy finish. I appreciate the clean ingredient list and the minimalist packaging. Overall, this makes a great daily sunscreen that can also be worn with makeup. Received this product for my honest review.

avis.titre: Lightweight enough to wear under makeup
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I like how this sunscreen rubs down on my skin, it's light enough to put on before applying my makeup. I do see a light tint at first so make sure you thoroughly rub it in if you have melanated skin.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Practically packaged and reasonably priced this facial mineral sunscreen feels protective and works well under makeup. It blends into my skin easily and then I leave it to settle for a few minutes before applying makeup. It has no white cast, no unpleasant scent, it didn't burn my eyes and it felt comfortable to wear.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Nice product. It isn't heavy and does a great job at protecting my skin from the sun's rays. It's smooth and saturates my skin. It seems to work well.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Nice product. It isn't heavy and does a great job at protecting my skin from the sun's rays. It's smooth and saturates my skin. It seems to work well.

avis.titre: Very Light and Does a Great Job Protecting My Skin
avis.texte: Nice product. It isn't too heavy and does a great job at protecting my skin from the sun's rays. It's smooth and saturates my skin. It works very well.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I was dying to trying this product. I always wanted to try a mineral sunscreen. It was lightweight, it spread easily. It was pleasant. However, my skin broke out. I let my skin heal which took a week and waited before attempting two more times. Unfortunately my skin broke out each time. I have sensitive skin but perhaps I am allergic to an ingredient in the sun screen? I don't know, but I am too self conscious about my skin to want to try this a fourth time and the long time it takes to heal.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Cute little size. Good for keeping in a make up bag or purse. No harsh scent, very lightweight and comes out very delicately so you don't end up with too much all over your hands.

I really liked this sunscreen, i took it on my Caribbean vacation and it protected my face from the harsh sun. I like that it is also unscented and is made from natural ingredients. My boyfriend liked it as well

What I like about this sunscreen serum is that there is no fragrance and/or the fragrance is very subtle. The application was smooth after my toner and other serums; however, my skin felt irritated and itchy throughout its drying process every time. The sunscreen serum says it is a good base/primer for makeup, although I did not experience this. I used this as a standalone without additional moisturizer or my usual makeup primer, and my makeup did not last throughout the day per usual if I would have used makeup primer. I like the SPF content but would not use this as a standalone moisturizer or makeup primer. I believe my sensitive combination skin just did not react well to this sunscreen serum.
Formula is super lightweight on the skin and did not cause any breakouts or irritation to skin!
Love this sunscreen! Feels weightless, no white cast, and keeps my skin soft all day. Perfect under makeup—finally a mineral SPF I actually enjoy using!
I love this sunscreen. It is light and fluffy; not heavy on the skin. It has a very light scent. It has great protection and does not irritate my skin.

I've been trying different sunscreens the past few months and this one is just right! The consistency is light and thin. Thin enough that I really don't even feel it on my skin. It goes great under my makeup. No color tint on your face. One of the things I like the most is there is no noticeable smell either. I requested a sample and received a full bottle! To be honest, I'm always more likely to buy from a company like that. Generous and it allowed me the time and use to fully appreciate this product!

I absolutely love the Daygleamer Mineral Sunscreen! It's super lightweight and feels great on the skin; it doesn't make my skin feel oily like some sunscreens. Also, there's no white cast. I'd definitely get this again!

This sunscreen is pretty good, but it still leaves white cast. The texture is very pleasant though, it's like a milky, lightweight essence. It definitely provides sun protection, and SPF 34 is a decent level for the city. If you apply too much, it pills a bit.
This sunscreen was very good loved using it and it made my skin have a nice glow to it will definitely purchase.
Really nice sunscreen. My daughter practically stole it from me. Doesn't irritate eyes, and feels nice on the skin.

I have been wanting to get a mineral sun screen and this one is really a great formula. It doesn't have any white cast and I wore it for hours at the pool in the sun and didn't get burned so it's a definite yes for me!
This worked well for me. It isn't greasy or heavy. I don't notice that I'm wearing it. I will be getting more of this.
This sunscreen is perfect to wear under makeup, it is invisible and is weightless.
Was an amazing product, scared at first bc of the whiteness but continued rubbing and it didn't leave a white cast like other competitors,
It felt really light on my skin and so easy to apply. Even though it is mineral, it did not leave any white cast on my skin. Very lightly scented, which I like.
I loved it! super light weight and went perfectly under my makeup which i was nervous about but i learned i had to let it sit before immediately applying.

This day day gleaner mineral serum goes on smooth & it did not leave my face white & it absorbs quickly. I don't think it's waterproof so it wouldn't be a option for the pool or beach ⛱️. This product I reviewed in exchange for my honest review.

I am outside daily riding horses and need a great sunscreen . I had opportunity to try Well people Daygleamer mineral serum broad spectrum SPF 34 . It is a bit watery when it first comes out but it is easily absorbed in your skin. It doesn't feel sticky or thick on your face and neck. Also doesn't leave a film that everything stick too. I recommend you try it so you can enjoy it too.

avis.titre: This is the fragrance free MVP
avis.texte: I like how light the texture is although its not sufficient for my dry skin right now. I hate fragrance in my facial products and I couldn't detect any in this one. I usually have a problem with experiencing a burning sensation when I use other sunscreens except for the 2 others I currently use and I didn't experience any with this one. Great overall product just not sufficient for the extremely dry patches I have around my nose and chin

very light and non-greasy feeling; didn't make me break out and didn't clog my pores; my only negative about it was it was not sweat proof, lasted about 2 hours in humid summer heat before I had to reapply. Also the bugs loved it, would like to have a sunscreen and *natural * bug repellant for mosquitos and others stinging, flying insects like red waspers
Applies very creamy, no white streaks left behind. Usable as is or with your daily makeup. I love the moisturizing feel and the love lasting wear.
I like how it absorbed in my skin. It didn't make my skin feel oily.
It's such an amazing item! I love how it easily glides and it super moisturizing!
Right off the bat it was easier to get out of the tube. Easier to spread and it absorbed right away. I didn't have to reapply it more than once. Very light smell.
Super light sunscreen that is mineral, so it's not formulated with as many chemicals! It glides on smooth and is great for slightly mature skin (33 years old) I highly recommend 🧴✨
Love the sample. It's very light and does what it needs to do. Will be purchasing it when available.
This Well people daygleamer serum is amazing. It has a light weight feel goes on smooth its not tacky or sticky and has a blur effect to it. 10/10 recommend
I love that this sunscreen doesn't make me look purple! It goes on so smooth and evenly. I wish they had one with higher spf.
I absolutely love this product it's not thick it leaves no white cast it's not greasy it's just out right phenomenal 😲🩷
It was very watery. It was easy to apply and didn't leave a white cast. But I couldn't tell if it provides UV protection. It didn't bother my eyes or skin.
I am greatly surprised about this product, it is great for all types of skin. I have super sensitive and acne prone skin and this sunscreen works very well and causes no clogged poors.
The quality is good but it does have a white cast to it. Definitely has to be worn with layers on top to cover.
The sunscreen applied well! There was no whitecast for me and it absorbed well! Didn't seem to irritate or breakout my skin either
This sunscreen moisturizer is incredibly lightweight and flawless. No smell. Smooth to apply.
I received a sample of Well People Daygleamer Mineral Suncreen. It was easy to apply. I like that it doesn't have an overpowering smell and works well in my skin routine before applying my makeup.
Goes on smoothly, feels light, and doesn't leave a white cast. Great for daily use!
I like it, it's gentle to my sensitive skin. But I like a higher SPF like 50 and above
I really like the daygleamer mineral sunscreen serum. It's lightweight and hydrating. It also provides a since glow to it.

i loved the thinner texture. blended really well. it played-well with makeup applied over the top. i was surprised with how mattifying it ended up--because of the texture, I was hoping it would leave a dewier glowy finish beneath my makeup. I overall liked it and will use again, but probably wouldnt purchase again.
Works great on its own and under makeup! Absolutely recommend!

Initially I was going to use this for myself but I was going on an outing with my 3 month old and was worried about him being in the sun. I remembered some parenting forums I had recently read stating that zinc oxide was the safest option to protect babies from sunburn so I decided to give it a try & I'm so happy I did!! This stuff is not too thick and not super runny, it doesn't leave any residue or have an overwhelming scent to it either, and my baby had no reaction -& get this, no sunburn!! So glad I received this sample & decided to give it a go, so if you're looking for a safe option for your baby 6 months and younger try this because it really works!!
This was a great mineral sunscreen option. Most serum textured sunscreens are chemical formulas, this was a nice mineral option. Also love the packaging.

This serum sunscreen is my new favorite skincare product. It gives sun protection and at the same time keeps my skin hydrated. It light weight and easy to smooth out in the skin and does not leave a white cast.

This product is amazing. I have sensitive skin and most SPF products irritate it, make me oily and cause break outs. This serum smells so good, gives me a beautiful glow and has the SPF benefits. Makeup goes on very easily over this as well.
Very light mineral sunscreen that I wear under makeup. It agrees with my foundation; it is gentle on my skin and provides needed protection.

avis.titre: All in one lotion and sunscreen
avis.texte: I am really enjoying this sunscreen, I use it at the final step of my skincare routine. It is hydrating enough that I can skip my normal moisturizer. Very blendable and comfortable to wear. I have tan skin and it does not leave a white cast. I also love that the active ingredient is non-nano zinc oxide, it's reef safe.
No white cast upon application, smoothen skin, lightweight, and has lots of other benefits like a skincare. It's clean, trusted, and affordable.
Really nice formulation, because of the unexpected extra coverage

I really love the formulas that Well People comes out with, but I noticed a slight white cast when I wore this sunscreen, unfortunately. I wish it was slightly more sheer. Other than that, I love the way they product feels.

First of all , I never expected a full size sample. Thank u so much . And to top it , it is very hydrating. First felt a little sticky but that feeling goes away in 5 min . I have combination sensitive skin . No breakouts yet . Has a bit of medicinal smell bcz of no fragrance but u get used to it . Maybe bcz im used to a light fragrance in all my products
This mineral sunscreen disappears on your skin and doesn't make it look white. It also doesn't leave it feeling sticky.

Got this amazing sunscreen for free and honestly I would buy it!! At first, it went on a little tacky and it's not thick because it's a serum k like I'm used to, but it dries down perfectly and pretty fast. It's sits well under makeup no white cast or pilling. I do wish the SPF was a little higher like 40 but I do like this product.
The consistency was so amazing, I believe the best I've ever felt. It didn't feel like regular sunscreen it's definitely something I will buy in the future.thanks guys
Non greasy and smooth coverage! Love how it blends into my skin

avis.titre: I never loved an SPF product until Now!
avis.texte: I was honestly in disbelief that this was a sunscreen. It felt more like a hydrating moisturizer but at the same time was very light on the skin. There was no heaviness to the sunscreen at all. Felt almost like I was wearing nothing. I definitely will always be keeping this on hand for those sunny days!

I'm usually a tinted sunscreen girl but I loved the lightweight serum consistency of this sunscreen! Blended in easily without a white cast and dried down fast! It also doesn't burn my eyes when I use it!
It has a very nice thin consistency but the smell is a little overpowering. I don't mind it as much as my daughter. She found it offensive to be close to me after I first applied!
This is a really great product! It goes on evenly and it doesn't leave any residue. It doesn't leave me feeling sticky it almost feels like I'm not wearing anything on my skin. I love this product!

I really like this sunscreen! It is very lightweight and easily spreads across the skin without leaving a white tint like a lot of mineral sunscreens do. It has also been very friendly with my skin (very acne-prone but also dry). A little goes a longgg way so I know it'll also last me. Can't wait for more!

Love this sunscreen so much! It goes on smoothly, no white cast, and leaves my skin feeling silky. It wears great under makeup, but I mostly wear it without makeup. It's lightweight and a little goes a long way. This will be a repeat buy for me.

This is a nice mineral sunscreen option, no lasting white cast or stinging. Is a little on the thinner side and comes out liquidy but absorbs quickly. Would consider buying again. Had trouble finding pregnancy safe mineral sunscreen options without salicylate and this was one of them.
Loved this sunscreen! Application was easy and the smell was perfect. It's long lasting and absorbs easliy
Not heavy or cakey like some SPFs feel! This goes on light and smooth and is invisible under make-up...or alone! Will be part of my daily routine!

This sunscreen blends in really nicely with no white cast as far as I can tell. It's a low viscosity formula, which is nice because it spreads very evenly, but I do tend to favor sunscreens that are a little thicker because they seem to lock in moisture. Most importantly, I could apply it near my eyes without my eyes watering and being irritated all day!
Mineral sunscreen usually leaves too much of a white appearance but this didn't so you can layer it. I would definitely recommend.

I always get scared with sunscreens that it's either going to leave a gray cast white cast or is not going to work well with my make up. And this is have to say has been one of the best sunscreens by far. It's thin it's lightweight It doesn't have that sunscreen smell that lingers forever, And it works well with makeup. I tend to wear either full face or just tinted moisturizer or just concealer and it has never disrupted my make up. It is a very thin formula once you spread it out so I kind of feel you have to use a little more than you would think to get good coverage. I need this in a powder for him with a brush so that this way I can do touchups throughout the day.
I really enjoyed the product. While it did leave a bit of a white cast, it eventually blended in fairly well and was nice under makeup.

avis.titre: So lightweight and no white cast.
avis.texte: I love that this product is a little bit watery because it feels so lightweight and easy to blend in. It works beautifully under my make up and I truly love it.
I loved this sunscreen. It went on smooth and was easy to remove too.
This is really good. Just the right consistency, enough moisturizing, but not too greasy.
Its really good sunscreen . Its very easy to apply and I like texture very much.
The best mineral sunscreen I have tried! Goes on like a dream- No white cast. 5 Stars!!!
This mineral sunscreen serum not only protects your face from the sun it also leaves you skin feeling soft and renewed.

Well People Daygleamer Mineral Sunscreen Serum SPF 34 is rich and creamy. It does not leave any white cast on my skin. The scent is nice and fresh. I received this product to test and I will be buying more.
I really enjoy using this product on my face. It is very light, not greasy and absorbs into the skin quickly.
The sunblock itself feels great on my skin. It's not greasy and leaves no white cast.
I absolutely love the serum texture. It blends right in and my face felt fantastic. Great protection too. Worked well with my makeup!
I loved everything about this sunscreen! It worked well under my makeup, almost as a primer. Did not pill or make my skin oily. It is fragrance free and absorbed into my skin nicely.

Gave this one to my daughter since she was looking for a new sunscreen to reduce her breakouts.. she loves it. Said it's non- greesy , smells pleasant, doesn't clog pores, works very well with her complexion, doesn't leave residue and spreads evenly.. she's very picky with skincare so I trust her judgment. Thanks for helping my 21 year old save some money and protect her skin!
Nice mineral sunscreen. The formula was nice creamy easy to apply. It didn't leave white cast. It was also good under the makeup.

I absolutely love the Sunscreen from Well People, because it has a smooth and effective texture and it does help protect me from the strong UV rats from the Sun. That us why I gave this Sunscreen 5 stars.

avis.titre: Blends well and adds a glow
avis.texte: I'm not a skincare/makeup fanatic so I'm always looking for easy solutions. This is great! Gives my skin just a little something c without worrying about color matching, blending, etc.

avis.titre: Blends well and adds a glow
avis.texte: I'm not a skincare/makeup fanatic so I'm always looking for easy solutions. This is great! Gives my skin just a little something c without worrying about color matching, blending, etc.
It has one of the best formulas. It's very lightweight and it doesn't leave white cast. I love it.

I live in Los Angeles, CA which means that sun here does NOT play. It is relentless and tries to burn us alive in the hot, summer months. I also suffer from an autoimmune illness where my body attacks my blood vessels manifesting in rashes and skin conditions. I am also a tanning bed user (I know, I know). All of this means, I am picky with skin and sun care products. You can't go wrong with Well People: quality, vegan ingredients, not tested on animals, etc. If anyone else cares about your skin.. it is Well People. The Daygleamer Mineeal Sunscreen serum is a little thin but blends well with no residue , preps skin for makeup if using on face and does not make you break put If I didn't react, neither will you. You will feel protected uaing this product and at a good price point!
love it, it's lightweight on my skin and leave's skin looking glowy
Smells like fruit loops use this on my makeup sometimes love how it's a big bottle very modern
This is the best sunscreen I have ever used. It makes my skin look flawless. I'll be purchasing a new bottle soon.
Love that it's lightweight yet still so hydrating and works great with the foundation stick

I saw a few reviews mention this, but it rolls off of your skin after applying. It applies fine when rubbing into your skin, but after a few minutes, it starts peeling off like dead skin. I'm not sure why, because this doesn't happen with other sunscreens I've tried. Kind of a bummer because I like the consistency and the lack of whitecast (after some rubbing). I just don't really understand why it'd peel like that.
I always love the smell of well products the texture was light only a little needs to be use or will leave a white cast felt good no greasy feeling no sting
My oily skin loved this sunscreen, it is perfect for everyday sun protection.
Excellent product if you have dry /combo skin with goodness of SPF. It feels like tinted moisturizer on the skin.
I find it pretty hard to find a non greasy spf and this one wasnt at all. I loved how i still felt like my skin, not my skin slathered with SPF.
